description: Defines the FineractPlatformTenantConnection class which holds database connection details for tenants in the Fineract platform, including connection parameters, schema info, and utility methods for URL and protocol extraction.

classes.name: FineractPlatformTenantConnection
classes.description: Represents tenant database connection details, including connection parameters, schema info, and utility methods for URL and protocol handling.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the connection, including schema name, server, port, and connection parameters if present.

methods.name: toJdbcUrl
methods.description: Constructs a JDBC URL string from protocol, host, port, database name, and parameters.

methods.name: toProtocol
methods.description: Extracts the protocol part of the URL from a DataSource connection.
